name: Shiiba Akina
source:
The protagonist's classmate, an eccentric who goes at his own pace.
In a good and bad way he's an honest person.
He has a weird habit of buying any new type of sweet even if it looks unappetizing.
He's played soccer since he was little and is a part of the school's soccer club.
